newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Five power firms plan to bid on Cemig shrs.
newsitem.headline: Five power firms plan to bid on Cemig shrs.

text.p: Five power companies have applied to pre-qualify for the auction of a 32.9 percent voting stake in Minas Gerais state power utility Cemig on May 6, a state official said.
An official at Minas Gerais Development Bank (BDMG) said the federal National Development Bank (BNDES), which owns the stake, is slated to announce the names of pre-qualified companies next Tuesday.

Southern Co, Community Energy Alternatives Inc, Pacific Corp, Artica Investment Corp and Brazilian power distributor Copel applied to pre-qualify for the auction, said the official, who requested anonymity.

The block sale of 18.7 million debentures convertible to Cemig's 32.6 percent voting stake to an strategic operator is scheduled to occur at the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange. The minimum price for each debenture was set at 60.37 reais ($57.03), he said.
